Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self,value,left=None,right=None): self.value,self.left,self.right=value,left,right

def lowest_common_ancestor(root, a, b):
    if root is None or root.value == a or root.value == b: return root
    left = lowest_common_ancestor(root.left, a, b)
    right = lowest_common_ancestor(root.right, a, b)
    if left and right: return root
    return left or right

root=TreeNode(2,TreeNode(1),TreeNode(3))
assert lowest_common_ancestor(root, 1, 3).value == 2
```
explanation: A recursive LCA algorithm searches both subtrees and joins when both sides return a match. O(n) time and O(h) space; this version assumes both target values exist.
